name: alignContainers
signature: alignContainers(keys: readonly ShapeKey[], opts?: AlignContainersOptions): TLShapeId[]
summary: Put every listed container on one size and return their ids.

name: attribute
signature: attribute(owner: ShapeKey, label: string, side: Side, opts?: AttributeOptions): { textId: TLShapeId; lineId: TLShapeId }
summary: Write a short label off one side of a box, joined by a bound line with no arrowhead, and return both ids.

name: box
signature: box(key: ShapeKey, label: string, opts?: BoxOptions): TLShapeId
summary: Create or update a labelled geo shape and return its id.

name: boxShapes
signature: boxShapes(keys: readonly ShapeKey[], opts?: BoxShapesOptions): TLShapeId
summary: Draw a labelled container behind a set of shapes and return its id.

name: clear
signature: clear(opts: ClearOptions = {}): number
summary: Delete every shape on the current page and return how many went.

name: column
signature: column(keys: readonly ShapeKey[], opts?: LineOptions): TLShapeId[]
summary: Lay existing shapes out top to bottom and return their ids in order.

name: connect
signature: connect(from: ShapeKey, to: ShapeKey, opts?: ConnectOptions): TLShapeId
summary: Draw an arrow bound at both ends and return its id.

name: describe
signature: describe(): InspectResult
summary: Everything on the current page: the same structure `inspect` prints.

name: fitCamera
signature: fitCamera(opts?: FitCameraOptions): Rect | null
summary: Fit the camera to every shape and return the bounds it framed.

name: getLints
signature: getLints(): Lint[]
summary: Run the lint pass over the current page and return the findings. Nine shape rules: `friendless-arrow`, `arrow-crosses-shape`, `line-crosses-label`, `overlapping-text`, `overlapping-shapes`, `off-page`, `empty-label`, `unreadable-label` and `missing-glyph`, plus `missing-topic` on the document.

name: grid
signature: grid(keys: readonly ShapeKey[], cols: number, opts?: GridOptions): TLShapeId[]
summary: Lay existing shapes out in rows of `cols` and return their ids in order.

name: line
signature: line(key: ShapeKey, x1: number, y1: number, x2: number, y2: number, opts?: DrawLineOptions): TLShapeId
summary: Draw an unbound line from one page point to another and return its id.

name: mermaid
signature: mermaid(source: string, opts: MermaidOptions = {}): ApplyPlanResult
summary: Parse a mermaid flowchart and draw it: boxes, bound arrows, and a container behind each subgraph.
examples: const { nodes, edges, containers, unsupported } = helpers.mermaid(source, { direction: 'LR' })

name: meta
signature: meta(patch?: MetaPatch): DiagramMeta | null
summary: Read or amend the document metadata: what this diagram is about.

name: note
signature: note(key: ShapeKey, str: string, opts?: NoteOptions): TLShapeId
summary: Create or update a sticky note and return its id.
examples: helpers.note('why', 'the cache is what makes this cheap', { after: 'page', gap: 80 })
helpers.note('aside', 'both panels hold the same arrow', { below: ['left', 'right'], gap: 60 })

name: page
signature: page(name: string): TLPageId
summary: Switch to a page by name, adding it when the document has none, and return its id. Everything drawn afterwards lands there.

name: plainText
signature: plainText(shape: ShapeKey | TLShape): string
summary: The visible text of a shape, read from its rich text.

name: remove
signature: remove(keys: ShapeKey | readonly ShapeKey[]): number
summary: Delete shapes by key or id and return how many actually went.

name: row
signature: row(keys: readonly ShapeKey[], opts?: LineOptions): TLShapeId[]
summary: Lay existing shapes out left to right and return their ids in order.

name: stub
signature: stub(key: ShapeKey, x: number, y: number, dx: number, dy: number, opts?: DrawLineOptions): TLShapeId
summary: `line` with a delta instead of a second point, and the same options.

name: text
signature: text(key: ShapeKey, str: string, opts?: TextOptions): TLShapeId
summary: Create or update a standalone text shape and return its id.
examples: helpers.text('title', 'the render loop', { x: 60, y: 0, size: 'l' })
helpers.text('title', 'two ways to read it', { above: ['left', 'right'], gap: 40, size: 'l' })

name: translate
signature: translate(keys: readonly ShapeKey[], dx: number, dy: number): TLShapeId[]
summary: Move shapes by `(dx, dy)` and return the ids that moved.
